messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick coordination thread for HelmBridge listing + security integration into Redwood marketplace. Need preflight items for SSO/SCIM/KMS and a lean partner announcement plan.

toni (PM): High level: 1) SAML IdP test 2) SCIM provisioning (user + group) 3) BYO-KMS/HSM wrap/unwrap path 4) secrets connector smoke 5) embargoed joint announcement.

jordan (HelmBridge): We can provide SAML metadata URL + cert bundle, staging SCIM endpoints, and an HSM gateway with a VPN endpoint for testing.

alex (Eng): Please share metadata via temp secure link. Also want an OIDC client as fallback. Can you include expected SAML NameID formats?

jordan (HelmBridge): Uploaded metadata: https://staging.helmbridge/files/idp-metadata.xml (48h). NameID formats: email and persistent. OIDC details will follow.

sam (Security): Requirements from our side: IP allowlist for SCIM callbacks, signed SCIM JWT option, HSM attestation (hardware cert + firmware hash), KMS key policy draft. Need these before we add BYO-KMS to the private deployment docs.

lee (SolutionsEng): Connector smoke plan: create user via SCIM, assign team/group, create secret via HelmBridge API, rotate key, fetch from Redwood runtime. I'll draft a runbook and share commands.

alex (Eng): Runbook sample (staging):
```
# SCIM create user
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.helmbridge/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>' -d '{"userName":"test+rbx","emails":[{"value":"eng+test@redwood.com"}]}'
# create secret
curl -X POST https://staging.helmbridge/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api-token>' -d '{"name":"rbx/test","value":"s3cret"}'
# fetch via Redwood
REDWOOD_SECRET=helmbridge://rbx/test node scripts/get-secret.js
```

toni (PM): Timing: target internal test Mon, partner run Tue, marketplace canary Wed. Legal wants embargo window and approved co-brand copy by Tue noon.

legal-bot: Action required: upload the latest partner MSA draft to /collab/partners/HelmBridge before Tue 11:00 PT. Noncompliance delays announcement.

jordan (HelmBridge): Noted. Legal will push MSA redline plus HSM attestation by tomorrow morning. OIDC creds by EOD.

sam (Security): Two technical concerns: 1) SCIM bulk import throttling behavior; 2) KMS latency and concurrency limits — we need p50/p95/p99 numbers and max inflight ops.

jordan (HelmBridge): SCIM: bulk endpoint supports chunking with throttling headers (X-Rate-Limit-*). KMS HSM stats (staging): p50=4ms, p95=12ms, p99=35ms, max concurrent ops 200. We'll provide telemetry.

lee (SolutionsEng): We'll implement exponential backoff using Retry-After and a jittered retry policy. Also will add queueing on Redwood connector side for bursts.

alex (Eng): Ops ask: can HelmBridge spin up a single-tenant staging HSM host in our test VPC (vpn + client cert)? saves latency noise.

jordan (HelmBridge): Yes, we can. Need contact person + source IP ranges.

maria (Partnerships): Action items so far:
- Jordan: upload SAML metadata, OIDC fallback, HSM attestation, MSA redline, telemetry (by EOD tomorrow)
- Alex/Lee: finalize runbook + connector throttling/backoff (by Mon morning)
- Sam: produce security checklist and IP allowlist template (today)
- Toni: draft embargo window and partner announcement copy (by Mon)

maria (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30-min smoke-run call Tue 09:00 PT. Invite will include the runbook and meeting checklist.

toni (PM): I'll send the invite and include engineering owners + legal.

alex (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness ready.

jordan (HelmBridge): Our infra lead will join and provide the HSM endpoint.

sam (Security): I'll sign off on security checklist during the call.

lee (SolutionsEng): I'll attach the connector test scripts to the calendar invite.

maria (Partnerships): Note: marketing copy must remain internal until Legal confirms co-brand wording. No external blog or tweet before both parties sign the announcement. :lock: :no_entry_sign:

jordan (HelmBridge): Understood. Thanks all.
